title: Witness at an input coordinate
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ input bits, let $w$ be an input assignment, and let $i$ be an input position. The circuit witness associated with $w$, evaluated at the coordinate for input $i$, equals the element of $mathbb{F}_2$ corresponding to the bit $w(i)$.
